description: This file defines interfaces, data structures, and classes related to transaction completion listener in Android's graphics system, including callback IDs, surface stats, transaction stats, and listener callback management.

classes.name: CallbackId
classes.description: Represents a callback identifier with type and optional jank data inclusion flag.

classes.name: ReleaseCallbackId
classes.description: Identifies a buffer release callback with buffer ID and frame number.

classes.name: FrameEventHistoryStats
classes.description: Stores statistics about frame events, including frame number, fences, and timing.

classes.name: JankData
classes.description: Contains information about surface flicker jank classification for frames.

classes.name: SurfaceStats
classes.description: Holds statistics related to a surface, including control, timing, and jank data.

classes.name: TransactionStats
classes.description: Aggregates callback IDs, timing, fences, and surface stats for a transaction.

classes.name: ListenerStats
classes.description: Holds statistics for a listener, including associated transaction stats.

classes.name: ITransactionCompletedListener
classes.description: Interface for transaction completion callbacks, including methods for completion, buffer release, queue stalled, and presentation change.

classes.name: BnTransactionCompletedListener
classes.description: Binder interface implementation for transaction completed listener.

classes.name: ListenerCallbacks
classes.description: Manages callback registration and filtering for transaction listeners.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Returns a new ListenerCallbacks filtered by callback type.
